zh: 策略净值随时间的分布：中位数、25–75% 和 5–95% 分位带，叠上基准的中位数。
en: The distribution of the strategy's wealth over time: the median and the 25–75% and 5–95% quantile bands, with the benchmark's median overlaid.

zh: equity 净值 曲线 fan 分位
en: equity wealth nav curve fan quantile percentile

zh: 粗线是所有对局的平均，带子是各局之间的差别：带子越宽，一局的结果越靠运气。
en: The thick line is the mean over all episodes, and the bands show the spread across episodes: the wider the bands, the more a single episode's result depends on luck.

zh: 带子越宽，结果越靠运气。对数坐标下，直线表示恒定的增长率。
en: The wider the bands, the more the result depends on luck. On a log scale, a straight line means a constant growth rate.

zh: 这个世界生成的价格：若干条样本路径，加上各时刻的分位带。
en: The prices this world generates: a number of sample paths, plus the quantile bands at each point in time.

zh: price path 价格 路径 世界

en: Out-of-sample (held back until the very end)

zh: 这是没有你的交易时市场本来的价格。
en: This is the price the market would have had without your trades.

zh: 实测：每步收益年化均值 §0§，年化波动 §1§（§2§§3§）。
en: Measured: annualized mean of per-step returns §0§, annualized volatility §1§ (§2§§3§).

zh: 所有路径期末净值的直方图，对照基准。
en: A histogram of terminal wealth across all paths, compared with the benchmark.

zh: terminal wealth 终值 分布 直方图 对数净值 期末净值
en: terminal wealth final wealth distribution histogram log wealth ending wealth

zh: 路径太少，画不出分布。真实数据可以改用滚动窗口，或换到 bootstrap 世界。
en: Too few paths to draw a distribution. With real data you can switch to rolling windows, or move to the bootstrap world.

zh: 每一局算一个数。结果栏里的得分是这些数的平均；分布越分散，同一条规则打一局的结果越说明不了问题。
en: Each episode yields one number. The score in the results bar is the mean of these numbers; the more spread out the distribution, the less the result of a single episode played with the same rule tells you.

zh: §0§均值高于中位数说明分布右偏：平均数被少数大赢家拉高，多数路径拿不到这个数。
en: §0§A mean above the median indicates a right-skewed distribution: the average is pulled up by a few big winners, and most paths do not reach it.
, not shown in the log chart.

zh: 每条路径从最高点回落的最大幅度。
en: For each path, the largest drop from its previous peak.

zh: drawdown 回撤 最大回撤 风险
en: drawdown max drawdown maximum drawdown risk
Too few paths to draw a distribution.

zh: 超过阈值的路径占 §0§（基准 §1§）。阈值在左栏"风险上限"里改。
en: §0§ of paths exceed the threshold (benchmark §1§). Change the threshold under "Risk cap" in the left column.

zh: 这个世界每一步收益的直方图，对照同均值、同方差的正态分布。
en: A histogram of this world's per-step returns, compared with a normal distribution of the same mean and variance.

zh: return distribution 收益 分布 厚尾 正态 偏度 峰度
en: return distribution returns heavy tails fat tails normal gaussian skewness kurtosis
Log-scale vertical axis (to see the tails)
Normal with the same mean and variance
§0§Skewness §1§, kurtosis §2§ (0 and 3 for a normal distribution). Minimum §3§, maximum §4§.

zh: 收益和收益绝对值在各个滞后上的自相关：前者看方向能否预测，后者看波动有没有记忆。
en: Autocorrelation of returns and of absolute returns at each lag: the former shows whether direction is predictable, the latter whether volatility has memory.

zh: acf autocorrelation 自相关 记忆 波动聚集 可预测
en: acf autocorrelation serial correlation memory volatility clustering predictable predictability

zh: 上图的柱子都在虚线以内，说明用过去的收益线性预测方向没有希望；下图明显为正，说明波动可以预测。非线性的依赖关系在这张图上看不出来。
en: When the bars in the upper panel all lie within the dashed lines, there is no hope of predicting direction linearly from past returns; when the lower panel is clearly positive, volatility is predictable. Nonlinear dependence does not show up in this chart.

zh: 挑一条路径，看价格、规则给出的仓位和净值怎么一步步走出来。
en: Pick one path and see how the price, the position given by the rule and the wealth unfold step by step.

zh: single path 单条 路径 仓位 买卖点 明细
en: single path one path position buy sell points trades detail

zh: 第 #§0§ 局：§1§；同一局里基准（§2§）§3§。各栏共用同一条横轴。
en: Episode #§0§: §1§; in the same episode the benchmark (§2§) §3§. All panels share the same horizontal axis.

zh: 路径 #§0§：期末净值 §1§，最大回撤 §2§。仓位在每一步收盘后决定，下一步才生效。
en: Path #§0§: terminal wealth §1§, max drawdown §2§. The position is decided after each step's close and takes effect only at the next step.

zh: （只画了第 §0§ 到 §1§ 个，共 §2§ 个）
把规则给出的仓位整体放大或缩小，看三种口径各自怎么变。增长率的峰值就是这条规则的 Kelly 倍数。
en: Scale the positions given by the rule up or down as a whole and see how each of the three criteria changes. The peak of the growth rate is this rule's Kelly multiple.

zh: leverage kelly 杠杆 仓位 倍数 增长率曲线 g(f)
en: leverage kelly position multiplier multiple growth curve growth rate curve g(f)
Region where some paths are ruined

zh: 仓位倍数 λ（1 = 当前规则）
夏普比率不随杠杆变化（除非碰到仓位上下限或成本）：它衡量的是信号的质量，不告诉你该押多大。
en: The Sharpe ratio does not change with leverage (unless the position floor or cap, or costs, come into play): it measures the quality of the signal and does not tell you how much to bet.

zh: 这批路径上的峰值在 §0§ ≈ §1§。峰值附近曲线很平，位置本身的误差不小；押过头比押不够的代价大得多。
en: On this batch of paths the peak is at §0§ ≈ §1§. The curve is very flat near the peak, and the location itself carries a sizable error; betting too much costs far more than betting too little.

zh: 不设风险上限时，期望收益随杠杆一直上升，最优解是"能借多少借多少"。实心点是满足回撤上限的最大值。
en: Without a risk cap, expected return keeps rising with leverage, and the optimum is "borrow as much as you can". The solid dot is the largest value that satisfies the drawdown cap.

zh: 让一个或两个参数在一段范围内取值，逐个回测，看目标随参数怎么变。
en: Let one or two parameters take values over a range, backtest each one, and see how the objective changes with the parameters.

zh: sweep scan 扫描 参数 热力图 优化 heatmap 最优
en: sweep scan parameter parameters heatmap heat map optimization optimize optimum best

zh: 把这批路径上最好的那组参数设为当前参数
en: Set the current parameters to the best parameter set on this batch of paths

zh: 仓位倍数不是规则自己的参数，请手动把仓位大小乘以 §0§
en: The position multiplier is not one of the rule's own parameters; multiply the position size by §0§ by hand

zh: 这条规则没有可以扫描的数值参数。换一条带参数的规则（比如带门槛、比例或系数的）再来。
en: This rule has no numeric parameters to sweep. Switch to a rule with parameters (for example one with a threshold, a fraction or a coefficient) and come back.

zh: 选好参数和范围，点"开始扫描"：每个取值都在同一批对局上打一遍。找到最好的取值之后，用结果栏里的"用新的一批对局检验"核对。
en: Choose the parameters and ranges, then click "Start sweep": every value is played once on the same batch of episodes. Once you have found the best value, check it with "Test on a fresh batch of episodes" in the results bar.

zh: 选好参数和范围，点"开始扫描"。扫描只用训练路径；找到最优点之后，用结果栏里的"§0§"核对。
en: Choose the parameters and ranges, then click "Start sweep". The sweep uses only the training paths; once you have found the best point, check it with "§0§" in the results bar.

zh: 这次扫描不是在当前的玩法里做的。重新扫描一次。
en: This sweep was not run in the current game. Run the sweep again.

zh: 这次扫描里没有模型的诊断数据。重新扫描一次，或者换成别的口径。
en: This sweep has no model diagnostics data. Run the sweep again, or switch to another criterion.

zh: §0§两条线之间的缺口就是过拟合：模型越灵活，训练集 R² 越高，验证集 R² 先升后降。§1§
en: §0§The gap between the two lines is overfitting: the more flexible the model, the higher the training-set R², while the validation-set R² first rises and then falls.§1§

zh: 验证集 R² 最高的点：§0§（§1§）。
en: Point with the highest validation-set R²: §0§ (§1§).

zh: 纵轴只画了最优值附近的一段，超出的部分被截掉了，悬停可以读到数值。
en: The vertical axis shows only a range around the best value; whatever lies beyond it is clipped, and you can hover to read the values.

zh: 绿色的宽带是理论曲线：细线落在带子里，说明模拟和推导对上了。
en: The wide green band is the theoretical curve: when the thin line falls inside the band, the simulation and the derivation agree.

zh: 这次比较了 §0§ 组参数：即使它们全无差别，其中最好的一组也会领先约 §1§ 个标准误，所以这个最优值是偏乐观的。
en: This sweep compared §0§ parameter sets: even if there were no difference at all among them, the best one would still lead by about §1§ standard errors, so this best value is on the optimistic side.

zh: 点一下格子可以把那组参数设为当前参数；实线框是最优点，虚线框是当前参数。
en: Click a cell to make that parameter set the current parameters; the solid frame is the best point and the dashed frame is the current parameters.

zh: 最多对比 6 条规则，请先移除一条
en: At most 6 rules can be compared; remove one first

zh: 这条规则不能用在当前的世界里
en: This rule cannot be used in the current world

zh: 把钉住的几条规则放在同一批路径上比：净值中位数，加上三种口径和配对差。
en: Compare the rules you have pinned on the same batch of paths: median wealth, plus the three criteria and the paired differences.

zh: compare 对比 多策略 比较
en: compare comparison strategies multiple rules side by side

zh: 还没有要对比的规则。在左栏调好一条规则后点"加入对比"。§0§
en: No rules to compare yet. Set up a rule in the left column, then click "Add to comparison".§0§

zh: 正在回测要对比的规则…
相对第 1 条的 Δg（配对）
所有规则打的是同一批对局，所以配对差比各自的标准误准得多。
en: All rules play the same batch of episodes, so the paired differences are far more precise than the rules' individual standard errors would suggest.

zh: 所有规则用的是同一批路径，所以最后一列的配对差比各自的标准误准得多。
en: All rules use the same batch of paths, so the paired differences in the last column are far more precise than the rules' individual standard errors would suggest.

zh: 对比里有带训练的规则：所有规则都只在训练段的后 §0§% 上回测，前面那一段留给模型学。
en: The comparison includes rules that need training: every rule is backtested only on the last §0§% of the training segment, and the earlier part is left for the model to learn from.

zh: 每个点是一条路径：横轴是它经历的最大回撤，纵轴是期末净值。
en: Each point is one path: the horizontal axis is the max drawdown it went through, and the vertical axis is its terminal wealth.

zh: scatter 散点 回撤 终值 风险 收益
en: scatter scatter plot points drawdown terminal wealth risk return

zh: 点一下查看这条路径的明细
en: Click to see this path's detail

zh: 只画了 600 条路径的抽样。
en: Only a sample of 600 paths is drawn.

zh: 当前规则没有训练模型。到规则里选"模型"一组，或者让 §0§ 写一个带 fit 的策略。
en: The current rule has no trained model. In the rule list, choose one from the "Model" group, or ask §0§ to write a strategy with a fit function.

zh: 模型学到的"下一步收益关于第一个特征"的函数，对照训练数据的分组均值；世界的真实条件期望能写出来时也画上。
en: The function the model has learned for "next-step return as a function of the first feature", compared with the group means of the training data; the world's true conditional expectation is drawn too when it can be written down.

zh: model learned function 模型 学到 条件期望 真值 拟合
en: model learned function conditional expectation truth ground truth fit fitted

zh: 这个模型没有给出可画的函数。
en: This model does not provide a function that can be plotted.

zh: 训练数据的分组均值（±1 标准误）
en: Group means of the training data (±1 standard error)

zh: 这个世界真实的条件期望（宽带）
en: This world's true conditional expectation (wide band)

zh: 绿色的宽带是这个世界里能达到的最好预测。蓝线落在带子里，说明模型学对了；蓝线跟着橙点的抖动走，说明它在拟合噪声。
en: The wide green band is the best prediction achievable in this world. If the blue line falls inside the band, the model has learned the right thing; if the blue line follows the wiggles of the orange dots, it is fitting noise.

zh: 这个世界的条件期望写不出来（或者不只依赖这一个特征），只能拿蓝线和橙点比：蓝线比橙点的走势更曲折，就是过拟合的迹象。
en: This world's conditional expectation cannot be written down (or does not depend on this one feature alone), so the blue line can only be compared with the orange dots: a blue line that wiggles more than the trend of the orange dots is a sign of overfitting.

zh: 预测准不准：训练集与验证集的 R²、IC、方向命中率，以及按预测值分组之后的校准图。
en: How accurate the predictions are: training-set and validation-set R², IC, directional hit rate, and a calibration plot after grouping by predicted value.

zh: model diagnostics 模型 诊断 r2 ic 校准 命中率 过拟合
en: model diagnostics diagnosis r2 r-squared ic calibration hit rate overfitting

zh: 验证样本太少，画不出校准图。
en: Too few validation samples to draw the calibration plot.

zh: 这一组的平均实际收益
en: Mean actual return in this group

zh: 验证集：按预测值从低到高分成 §0§ 组
en: Validation set: split into §0§ groups by predicted value, from low to high

zh: 完全校准（预测 = 实际）
验证集 R² 不大于 0：在没见过的数据上，这个模型还不如直接用均值去猜。
en: Validation-set R² is not greater than 0: on data it has not seen, this model does no better than guessing the mean outright.

zh: 验证集 R² 为 §0§：按预测值成比例下注，每步夏普约 √(R²/(1+R²)) = §1§（年化约 §2§，不计成本）。
en: Validation-set R² is §0§: betting in proportion to the predicted value gives a per-step Sharpe of about √(R²/(1+R²)) = §1§ (about §2§ annualized, before costs).

zh: 验证集 R² 为 §0§：下一步在很大程度上可以预测。真实的价格序列里见不到这么高的数，见到了先怀疑用了未来的数据。
en: Validation-set R² is §0§: the next step is predictable to a large extent. Real price series do not show numbers this high; if you see one, first suspect that future data was used.

zh: 训练集比验证集高出 §0§，过拟合明显。
en: The training-set R² exceeds the validation-set R² by §0§: clear overfitting.

zh: §0§IC 是预测值与实际值的相关系数；点落在虚线上说明预测的大小也是对的，不只是方向。
en: §0§ IC is the correlation coefficient between predicted and actual values; points lying on the dashed line mean that the size of the prediction is right too, not only the direction.

zh: 把验证集里某个特征的取值打乱，看预测误差增加多少（置换重要性）。
en: Shuffle the values of one feature in the validation set and see how much the prediction error increases (permutation importance).

zh: feature importance 特征 重要性 置换
打乱后验证集 R² 的下降
en: Drop in validation-set R² after shuffling

zh: §0§。负值或接近 0 的柱子表示模型没有真正用到这个特征（或者用错了）。
en: §0§. A bar that is negative or close to 0 means the model is not really using that feature (or is using it wrongly).

zh: 把规则里的某个选项（比如用哪个模型）逐个换一遍，各自训练、回测，把预测力和增长率放在一起比。
en: Go through every value of one option in the rule (for example, which model to use), train and backtest each one, and compare predictive power and growth rate side by side.

zh: model compare arena 模型 对比 擂台 比较 横评 过拟合 选模型
en: model compare comparison arena side by side overfitting model selection choose a model

zh: 当前规则没有可以逐个比较的选项。选"预测模型流水线"，就能把十种模型放在一起比。
en: The current rule has no option whose values can be compared one by one. Choose "Prediction pipeline" to compare ten models side by side.
Training and backtesting one by one…

zh: §0§点"开始对比"："§1§"的 §2§ 个取值会在同一批路径上各自训练并回测一次。
en: §0§Click "Start comparison": each of the §2§ values of "§1§" is trained and backtested once on the same batch of paths.

zh: 世界、参数或交易设定变了，上一次的对比已经过期。
en: The world, the parameters or the trading settings have changed, so the last comparison is out of date.

zh: 训练集 R²（两点的距离就是过拟合的程度）
en: Training-set R² (the distance between the two points is the degree of overfitting)

zh: 长期增长率（§0§，±1 标准误）
长期增长率 ± 1 标准误
算得多快、存了多少（用时是在这台设备上量的）
en: How fast it runs and how much it stores (times were measured on this device)

zh: 记号：n 训练样本数，d 特征数，k 近邻数，B 树的棵数，h 树的深度，H 隐层宽度，E 训练轮数，I 迭代轮数。
en: Notation: n = number of training samples, d = number of features, k = number of neighbors, B = number of trees, h = depth of a tree, H = width of the hidden layer, E = number of training epochs, I = number of iterations.

zh: 各种算法的计算量和存储怎么比
en: How the algorithms compare in compute and memory

zh: 两者不是同一个：预测得准只是一半，仓位怎么随预测变、换手多少同样决定收益。
en: The two are not the same one: predicting accurately is only half of it; how the position changes with the prediction, and how much turnover there is, likewise determine the return.

zh: 比较了 §0§ 个取值，即使它们全无差别，最好的那个也会领先约 §1§ 个标准误；选定之后用"用新路径检验"核对。
en: §0§ values were compared; even if there were no difference at all among them, the best one would still lead by about §1§ standard errors. After choosing one, check it with "Test on fresh paths".

zh: 这张图回答什么问题、怎么读
en: What question this chart answers and how to read it

zh: 行数较多，表格里做了等间隔抽取。
en: There are many rows, so the table shows an evenly spaced selection of them.

zh: 这张图在当前的世界里用不上
en: This chart does not apply in the current world
Model diagnostic charts are now shown

en: The rule failed to run; see the error message above
